description: Water drops and the ribbon waterfall of the school drain (map1_s02, map1_s03; the stream's shape is the map variable water_stream in config/map_vars.json). Drops are particle slots of group 27 (stopping clears groups 27 and 28). gravity_cap: fastest fall speed (Q12 per frame, 24576 = 6). spawn_speed_* / fall_speed_*: random range of a drop's speed scale, spawn_speed_shift divides it. max_x / max_y: a drop whose last corner lands outside this screen box is skipped. drop_* / ribbon_*: palette (clut) and texture page words. Every key is checked. A mod replaces the whole file with its own copy at the same path.
